test_cases.name: Describe Scene
test_cases.input_type: Single Optical RGB GeoTIFF / Satellite Image (Cartosat-2S style)
test_cases.user_question: Describe this satellite scene in detail.
test_cases.expected_ai_output: Optical satellite scene featuring vegetation (~38.2%), water body (~12.5%), and urban edge patterns (8.4%). Georeference CRS: EPSG:4326.
test_cases.actual_model_output: Optical satellite scene featuring vegetation (~38.2%), water body (~12.5%), and urban edge patterns (8.4%).
supporting_evidence: Pixel Feature Extraction: Mean Brightness 95.7, Edge Density 8.4%
Greenness Vegetation Index (ExG): 38.2% visible vegetation coverage
Water Absorption Index (ExB): 12.5% surface water body detection
test_cases.limitations: Spectral interpretation is restricted to visible RGB bands; genuine multispectral NDVI requires 4+ band GeoTIFF with NIR.

test_cases.name: Locate Buildings
test_cases.input_type: Single Optical RGB / High-Edge Urban Satellite Image
test_cases.user_question: Locate the buildings in this scene.
test_cases.expected_ai_output: High structural edge density (8.4%) and texture variance confirm urban building settlements across the area.
test_cases.actual_model_output: High structural edge density (8.4%) and texture variance confirm urban building settlements across the area.
supporting_evidence: OpenCV Contour Analysis: 2 building cluster bounding boxes detected

confidence_calibration.method: Contour area ratio & Canny edge density contrast

test_cases.limitations: Bounding box coordinates are image-relative normalized [0, 1]. In imagery lacking distinct building contours, returns 'Building structures are not clearly identifiable from the provided imagery.' without inventing fake boxes.

test_cases.name: Bi-Temporal Change
test_cases.input_type: Bi-Temporal Optical GeoTIFF Pair (T1 before, T2 after)
test_cases.user_question: What changes occurred between these two satellite images?
test_cases.expected_ai_output: Bi-temporal pixel-level analysis detects 14.8% land-cover alteration between T1 and T2 imagery.
test_cases.actual_model_output: Bi-temporal pixel-level analysis detects 14.8% land-cover alteration between T1 and T2 imagery.
supporting_evidence: Siamese Image Differencing: Absolute pixel delta |I_T2 - I_T1| thresholding
Changed Area Percentage: 14.8% of total scene altered
Change Map Highlight: Pixel cluster bounding box in top-right quadrant [0.098, 0.684, 0.293, 0.879]

confidence_calibration.method: Pixel delta SNR and Otsu noise cutoff thresholding

test_cases.limitations: Sub-pixel image co-registration alignment error can contribute to minor boundary false positives. Mismatched CRS triggers explicit reprojection warnings.

test_cases.name: Optical-SAR Fusion
test_cases.input_type: Optical RGB GeoTIFF + SAR C-band GeoTIFF (RISAT / Sentinel-1 style)
test_cases.user_question: Analyze this scene using optical and SAR information.
test_cases.expected_ai_output: Gated Optical-SAR Dual Stream analysis combines optical surface reflectance (Edge Density: 8.4%) with SAR radar backscatter (High Specular: 11.2%, Low Absorption: 18.5%), confirming physical target presence.
test_cases.actual_model_output: Gated Optical-SAR Dual Stream analysis combines optical surface reflectance (Edge Density: 8.4%) with SAR radar backscatter (High Specular: 11.2%, Low Absorption: 18.5%), confirming physical target presence.
supporting_evidence: Optical Branch: Surface color spectrum & edge density 8.4%
SAR Branch: High specular double-bounce backscatter 11.2% (urban structures)
SAR Branch: Low absorption backscatter 18.5% (smooth surfaces/water)
test_cases.limitations: SAR backscatter is treated as radar intensity (dB scale), not optical RGB. Requires co-registered spatial bounds.
